caption.case: upper for emphasis phrases, sentence otherwise
caption.size_rel: 0.055 of frame height, bottom-third, one short clause per card, black outline + white fill

layout.host_pos: centered, medium shot, seated, chest-up, static camera, plain wall background
layout.safe_zones: top 8% reserved for title card only at hook; bottom 15% reserved for platform UI (like/share icons) so captions sit mid-lower third not at very bottom
layout.caption_pos: lower-middle third, centered horizontally, 1 short animated phrase burned in per beat, changes every 1-2s in sync with speech

transitions: hard cut from title card to talking head at t=0-1s
hard cut talking-head <-> full-screen doc/article screenshot ~6-8 times across 100s
no crossfades, no camera movement, static locked-off shot throughout

themeable: accent (red highlight color used for emphasis boxes/underlines on screenshots)
doc/article screenshot content (swap in any reference article)
title/hook card text and background color
host identity/outfit (talking-head slot is a themeable component, not tied to this specific presenter)
